name: code-review
description: Structured code review with a language-agnostic core and on-demand Go, TypeScript, and Rust rules.

interface.shortDescription: Structured code review for Go, TypeScript, and Rust
interface.longDescription: Evidence-based code review covering correctness, error handling, performance, security surface, test quality, and conventions, with language-specific rules loaded only for languages present in the diff.
